events.event: Magnus is born in an unnamed coastal village in Elysia.
Magnus first publicly demonstrates water magic.
As a young adult, Magnus reads The Paths of Magic and begins his quest.
Magnus defeats the Fire Avatar and masters fire.
Magnus reaches Tximistarri and masters lightning.
Magnus discovers the Mage Tower and studies there for weeks.
Magnus defeats the Lich King sealed beneath the tower.
Magnus enchants the Longsword of the Lifeforce of Elysia.
Magnus crosses the portal to Azeroth and defeats the Enderdragon.
Magnus returns to Elysia and becomes master of the Mage Tower.
